newsitem.title: UK: UK insurers must nurture long-term care - industry.
newsitem.headline: UK insurers must nurture long-term care - industry.

text.p: The UK long-term care market represents a huge opportunity for growth, but insurers should not rush in and repeat the mistakes they have made elsewhere, an industry expert said on Thursday.

"Long-term care presents a tremendous challenge to the insurance industry, but the rewards for getting it right will be very great indeed," Desmond Le Grys, former Munich Re UK general manager, told an Insurance Institute of London seminar.
"However, we cannot run the risk of another scandal along the lines of home income policies or pensions."
Le Grys outlined a range of options for the industry and government to consider when addressing the growing problem of funding long term care,
Partnership schemes between the state, individuals and insurers were the way he favoured to fund long term care (LTC) in the future.
This would involve individuals who could afford it in buying long-term care insurance. The state would remain responsible for those who could not afford to buy LTC insurance.
The onus on insurers was to come up with affordable schemes, he said, while government should encourage personal LTC provision in similar ways to its support for personal pensions.
For the next 5-10 years, insurers should concentrate on the over 65 market and then focus on encouraging younger people to plan long term.

Le Grys said Britain does not have a rapidly ageing population and did not face the so-called demographic time-bomb phenomenon confronting many other developed countries which have falling birth-rates.
However, two other factors were driving up the cost of long term care.

Firstly, people were demanding higher standards of care for themselves and their relations. Secondly, the level of informal care by friends and relations was declining, placing greater demand on the state.

Around 70 percent of care is provided informally, often by female relations, but as more women work, families become more mobile and divorce increases, fewer were willing or able to take on this responsibility.
